prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE continuous 360-degree equirectangular horizontal panorama band for a fixed-camera JRPG scene. Output an EXTREMELY WIDE 4:1 image, as high native resolution as possible (target 4096 x 1024). This is a 360 degrees horizontal by 90 degrees vertical panoramic strip (latitude +45 to -45), NOT an ordinary wide-angle view and NOT a collage, grid, panels or separate pictures. Input image1 is the location composition reference, image2 is the approved painting style reference. Re-create the SAME small medieval fantasy lantern market with bold elegant brown outlines, painted cel-shadow stone facets, warm pale honey limestone and terracotta, natural gold-green vines, blue-violet shadows, no photographic noise. Preserve all landmarks and their order: the lantern-maker stall in the exact middle of the panorama (front, 0 degrees), a modest covered stone well to its right (right direction), green-fronted apothecary storefront further right, the street leading to the square opposite the stall at the panorama's matching far left/right borders (back direction), modest cream stone townhouses on the left. All architecture must belong to one ring of street surrounding the stationary viewer at human eye height 1.65 metres. Maintain one level ground and ONE common horizon at exactly half image height, equal-angle spherical projection, no zoomed-in panels, no change of eye position across directions. Stalls and doors have believable human sizes, lanterns 20-40cm, counter about 1m high, 2.2m doors. Leave the bottom part as clear empty stone roadway for separate character sprites. The far left and far right edges MUST join seamlessly, same continuing pavement lines, walls and sky. A gentle variation in paved-street width and several connected exits, no disconnected roads. No people, no UI, no lettering, no watermarks, no framing, no blur. Avoid a miniature world, giant lanterns, duplicate floating cities, abrupt street-level changes. This continuous master will replace independently painted faces specifically to eliminate road/corner seams. Preserve the reference art style and location.

Bold confident brown drawn contours, warm honey/cream stone, blue-violet shadow shapes, golden-green ivy, terracotta, clean hand-painted facets. Preserve landmarks and their order with the main front landmark at exactly 50% horizontal position, rightward view around75%, the backward street at the joining far left/right edges, left view around25%. All these directions share ONE level road at believable human scale. Front doors about2.2m tall, counters about1m high, small domestic lanterns, not giant. Foreground is clear road for separate sprites. Far left and far right edges must match seamlessly in sky, ground height, curb continuation and architecture. No people, lettering, UI, frame, watermarks, collage divisions, blur or photographic noise. Maintain the old location's atmosphere and painting style. No disconnected road planes, no raised or floating extra cities. This is the street outside the magical tavern. Right-hand lanes lead past simple warm townhouses. Back at the panorama wrap: the tavern's large wooden entrance with a modest brass star emblem. Left: the ivy-covered stone wall and a street lamp. The arch is not a viewing window into a second city in the sky; no floating skyline above it. Preserve the approved reference's nearby arch and tavern frontage.
